description: Figure 9 is a grouped bar chart that illustrates the effect of context masking perturbations on model probing accuracy, categorized by grammatical tag. The horizontal axis displays four different tags: "case", "gender", "number", and "tense". The vertical axis represents the "effect" of the perturbation, which is defined as a percentage of the original accuracy, with a scale ranging from -5 to 20. For each tag, there are six bars, each corresponding to a different model and layer configuration, as indicated by the legend: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light red), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). Error bars on top of each bar represent the standard deviation. The chart shows that the effect is most pronounced for the "case" tag, where all models exhibit a significant positive effect, with mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ showing the highest values, both exceeding 10. For the "gender", "number", and "tense" tags, the effects are much smaller and mostly close to zero, with some models showing slight negative effects, indicating a minor improvement in accuracy due to the perturbation.
